crossRefs.note: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death.…
“Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing…
then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do…
You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal…
Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have…
Give heed to me, Yahweh, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.

translations.web: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.
translations.bsb: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
translations.kjv: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
translations.asv: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.
